correctness.rationale: Independently re-ran enumeration from scratch (fresh segmented sieve, not just replay script): count 96417, first 1000000007, last 1001999989, max consecutive difference 196 occurring once at (1001755423,1001755619). Gap-spectrum checksums match: 86 even values, counts sum to 96416, weighted sum 1999982 = last-first. Searched prime set independently: 33 quadruplets of shape (p,p+2,p+6,p+8) with least 1000025261 (all four members trial-division prime), zero sextuplets of either pattern (0,4,6,10,12,16) or (0,2,6,8,12,18). Ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py: VERIFY_OK (count, maxgap, quad, sextuplet-zero, 8 MR transcript replays, 195 interior factors). Independently verified both gap endpoints prime by trial division to sqrt (~31656) and by deterministic Miller-Rabin bases {2,7,61}; verified every interior integer strictly between endpoints composite (explicit divisor; spot re-factored). Merit 196/ln(1001755423)=9.457168... confirmed. Draft honestly separates proved items 1-5 (machine-checked enumeration) from computed heuristic item 6 (Hardy-Littlewood floating-point expectations via Euler product truncated at 2e5: S4~4.15119, S6~17.29871, ~45.02 quad / ~0.437 sex) and imported baseline pi(1e9)=50847534 (not re-derived; contribution is window count 96417 and implied sum 50943951). No boundary error: endpoints 1000000007 and 1001999989 are interior to closed I; even interior gap members covered by factor 2; gap definition q-p used consistently (195 composites between, i.e. PrimePages g=195).

originality.rationale: Substantively compared against nearest priors fetched live. PrimePages 'Gaps Between Primes' and 'Table of Known Maximal Gaps' record only global first-occurrence/record gaps (e.g. gaps 287 after 1294268491, 291 after 1453168141, 319 after 2300942549, through 1853) with bare values and no window census, certificates, or constellation spectra for [1e9,1e9+2e6]; their gap convention (composites between, g=q-p-1) differs but does not change the conclusion since 196 (q-p) is far below global-record scale. Visser arXiv:1904.00499 verifies Firoozbakht/Nicholson/Farhadian conjectures globally below the 81st maximal gap (p<2^64) and computes no 1e9 window-maximal gap or k-tuple census. Kourbatov arXiv:1401.6959 proves a Gumbel limit law for maximal gaps in Cramer's random model (plus constellation extension) — probabilistic theory, not an empirical certified window census; the claimed spectra would test such predictions, not transcribe them. No source publishes the certified window-maximum 196 at (1001755423,1001755619) with transcripts and interior-factor proof, the 33-quadruplet/0-sextuplet census, or the 86-value gap spectrum for this fixed window. pi(1e9)=50847534 is a known baseline but does not imply the window-maximum, endpoint identities, or constellation counts.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object: the window-maximal consecutive-prime gap G*=196 (q-p), unique, at (1001755423,1001755619) in the fixed round-number window [1e9,1e9+2e6], with full MR certificate chain and interior-factor maximality proof, plus exact window census (96417 primes), 33 quadruplets with first witness, zero sextuplets of both admissible patterns, and complete 86-value spectrum. Object and invariant were motivated before computation (empirical maximal gaps testing Cramer/Granville predictions; Hardy-Littlewood k-tuple occurrence ratios; verified-pi/sieve benchmarks at the standard 1e9 scale; width 2e6 chosen so expected maximal gap ~150-200 lies inside), the values are not known or mechanically implied by global record tables or pi(1e9) alone, and a future researcher (prime-tuple benchmarking, sieve-correctness checks, verified-pi programs) could reasonably need the precise fact. This is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration: endpoint identities, uniqueness, and constellation counts are newly computed exact data with replayable proofs, and HL figures are honestly labeled heuristics, not the value claim. Certification supports but does not substitute for the new exact facts.

Independent quadruplet/sextuplet recount: 33 quads least 1000025261; 0 sextuplets of either pattern.
Trial-division primality of both endpoints to sqrt plus deterministic MR(2,7,61) replay; all 195 interior integers composite with explicit divisors.

residual_risks: Hardy-Littlewood expectations (~45.02 quad, ~0.437 sex) are truncated-Euler-product floating-point heuristics, not theorems; draft correctly labels them as such.
pi(1e9)=50847534 is an imported baseline, not recomputed; only window count 96417 and implied sum 50943951 are established here.
Miller-Rabin determinism below 2^32 for bases (2,7,61) is assumed as a known theorem (Jaeschke/Sinclair); interval lies below 2^32.
Gap convention is q-p (=196); readers using PrimePages g=q-p-1 should read it as 195 composites between.
